# Hare Krishna Movement Chennai

> Official website of Hare Krishna Movement (HKM) Chennai, also known as ISKCON Chennai / ISKCON Thiruvanmiyur. A spiritual and cultural organization dedicated to spreading the teachings of Bhagavad Gita and the practice of Krishna Consciousness, founded under the guidance of His Divine Grace A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Srila Prabhupada.

## About

Hare Krishna Movement Chennai (HKM Chennai) is a spiritual organization based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Also referred to as ISKCON Chennai or ISKCON Thiruvanmiyur, the organization operates temples, conducts free Bhagavad Gita classes, organizes cultural festivals, runs youth and children's programs, and serves free vegetarian meals (Annadanam) to the community.

## Temple Locations

- **Dakshina Dwaraka** — Main temple and cultural center in Chennai
- **Thiruvanmiyur Center** — ISKCON Thiruvanmiyur center for spiritual programs
- **Mogappair Center** — Community center for children's programs

## Key Programs

- **Gita Life** — Free weekly Bhagavad Gita study sessions for adults
- **FOLK (Friends of Lord Krishna)** — Youth spiritual development club
- **ICVK (Indian Culture & Values for Kids)** — Weekend cultural and spiritual education for children ages 3-15
- **Soulful Sangam** — Community kirtan and devotional music gatherings
- **Sunday Retreats** — Weekly spiritual retreat programs
- **Annadanam** — Free food distribution service
- **Spiritual Discourses** — Regular lectures on Vedic philosophy

## Donation & Seva

- Deity Seva, Gopala Seva, Pandava Seva, Sudama Seva
- Festival sponsorships: Ratha Yatra, Ram Navami, Gaura Purnima, Janmashtami
- Annadanam (free meal distribution)
